issue_request: FHIR-11167 was a Published Patient Care change request for DSTU2 ClinicalImpression. It requested removal of ClinicalImpression.plan and removal of the scope wording that included actions taken during or planned as a result of the clinical assessment.
initial_application: Commit bd9f60dbffee762fd2b3e49ee2e07e232b9685a9 historically removed ClinicalImpression.plan from the authored spreadsheet, removed the example plan entry, and changed the ClinicalImpression introduction to omit the planned-actions phrase.
additional_context: FHIR-7185 later confirmed that ClinicalImpression.plan had already been removed because a later-created plan should point back to the earlier clinical impression. FHIR-46596 renamed ClinicalImpression to ClinicalAssessment, and commit fad1b9cf84ef652e88947e1a13b026c62f95334e then removed ClinicalAssessment from source/fhir.ini active configuration and linked the Clinical Summary module to the PC incubator ClinicalAssessment artifact. The related FHIR-11168 audit is already present on the combined branch and reached the same current-build-scope conclusion for ClinicalImpression.action.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Neither ClinicalImpression nor ClinicalAssessment has an active source/fhir.ini resource entry in the current core build, and current checks found no plan/action element or old planned-actions phrase in the remaining inactive source folders.
